hits.snippet: Netsertive launches AI-native MLX 3.0 platform for multi-location marketing command centres | Dealroom.co ... Netsertive launches AI-native MLX 3.0 platform for multi-location marketing command centres ... Netsertive has launched version 3.0 of its Multi-Location Experience Platform, transforming it into an AI-native marketing command centre for franchise and multi-location brands. The Morrisville-based marketing technology provider announced the update on 3 August. The platform consolidates fragmented local data into a single source, enabling marketers to track performance and manage campaigns across multiple locations. It integrates AI models from Amazon Bedrock, Snowflake's Cortex, and Google's Gemini to deliver automated insights and recommendations. Key features include an AI chat assistant, call insights tool, and a web content editor for managing distributed location pages. The platform also offers an interactive directory showing which marketing products and services individual locations have activated. Netsertive serves over 1,500 retailers, franchises, and auto dealers.
